package.name: ankybot_i2c_bridge
package.description: C++ I2C bridge: pca9685_commander_node drives the PCA9685 servo driver directly from the Pi over I2C (subscribes /joint_commands), and mega_feedback_reader_node polls the Arduino Mega's I2C feedback slave (arduino_mega_i2c_slave.ino) and republishes /joint_states. Replaces the old serial_communication_py package (serial-based bridge and its Python I2C fallback nodes), deleted 2026-07-20 - this is now the only I2C actuation path.
